content:
Next month Apple TV will premiere Lucky, a new original series starring Anya Taylor-Joy. The full trailer for Lucky just dropped, and it looks promising.

Lucky premieres July 15 on Apple TV, here’s the trailer

One of the expected highlights of Apple TV’s best summer lineup ever is Lucky, a new limited series starring and executive produced by Anya Taylor-Joy.

Lucky premieres Wednesday, July 15 with its first two episodes, followed by weekly releases through August 19.

Alongside Taylor-Joy, the series also stars Annette Bening, Timothy Olyphant, Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor, Drew Starkey, Clifton Collins Jr., and William Fichtner.

It’s based on the bestselling Lucky novel by Marissa Stapley, which is available on Amazon and Apple Books.

Here’s Apple’s official summary, followed by the new trailer:

Jonathan Tropper, who created Your Friends & Neighbors, is also the creator of Lucky.

Anya Taylor-Joy’s last big TV series was her breakout role in Netflix’s The Queen’s Gambit. Her only previous appearance on Apple TV was the film The Gorge, which premiered last year.

Are you planning to watch Lucky? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.
